prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the JOBE desktop marketing homepage
Primary request: Design a real desktop website surface for JOBE, a founder-led senior engineering consultancy. This is composition C, “FOLDED ATLAS,” within the approved SYSTEMS WAYFINDING visual world. Show the navigation, complete first viewport, and enough of the following case/services transition to prove the page system. The first viewport is one continuous technical atlas folded into three unequal vertical planes: a near-white proposition plane, a dominant deep-blue architecture plane, and a narrow pale decision plane for João’s annotation and the primary action. One route crosses every fold and physically connects the three. Below the fold, the same route enters the current homepage sections as indexed destinations rather than cards.
Surface structure in order: compact header integrated into the atlas top edge; left 38% proposition with oversized headline and real description; center 44% deep-blue architecture topology with a diagnosis junction; right 18% decision rail with João annotation, Product Readiness Call action, StockCast secondary path, language/theme controls; lower fold reveals the start of an evidence checkpoint and three service destinations along one horizontal route.
Style/medium: high-fidelity flat web UI design, precise contemporary infrastructure wayfinding, matte, editorial, production-believable
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape desktop webpage, browserless, straight-on; three unequal vertical planes with visible fold seams; hero occupies 75% height; one route crosses all planes; lower section visible; headline and architecture field share dominance; narrow decision rail creates tension and a memorable silhouette
Color palette: deep engineering blue #173D8F carries 35–45% of the surface, near-white #F5F7FA, ink #111722, pale route blue #9FB5DF only; no second accent hue; no gradients
Typography: authoritative narrow grotesk inspired by infrastructure signage, not a system font, not monospace; giant compact headline, disciplined indexed labels, strong numerals
Materials/components: folded system-map planes, enamel-signage blue, clipped hard-edged plates, fold seams, 1–2px topology paths, route nodes, legend marks; almost no rounded rectangles; flat depth
Text (verbatim where legible): “JOBE”, “Engineering that Works”, “A senior engineering practice for AI products that need to work in production—and for the business.”, “Book a Product Readiness Call”, “Explore StockCast”, “AI Productization Sprint”, “Fractional CTO & Architecture”, “AI-Native SDLC & Engineering Enablement”, “StockCast”. Do not invent any other claims, metrics, customers, credentials, prices, or logos. Minor explanatory text may be greeked.
Founder evidence: include a compact decision-rail plate labeled only “JOÃO BERTACCHI” with greeked annotation lines; do not invent a title, biography, or credential.
Responsive intent implied: the three folds clearly stack into one vertical route rail on mobile without hiding the map.
Constraints: preserve current homepage section inventory and diagnostic-first story; architecture diagram is meaningful topology, not decorative circuitry; primary action remains immediately visible; accessible contrast; no browser chrome
Avoid: generic split hero, wireframe cube, three equal floating cards, dashboard chrome, bento grid, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, neon hacker aesthetic, fake data, fake score values, stock illustration, 3D objects, excessive pills, excessive rounded cards, generic AI landing page, watermark
